### workspace init --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace init [options]

Set up workspace by installing tmuxinator templates and creating
the config directory if it doesn't exist.

Options:
        --dry-run                    Show what would be done without making changes
    -f, --force                      Overwrite existing templates even if they differ
        --install-hooks              Install agent session hooks without asking
        --no-install-hooks           Skip the agent session hooks step
        --workflow-sources VALUE     Add workflows.sources entries to the global config (repeatable; commas or newlines separate several)

Examples:
  workspace init    # install templates and create the config directory
  workspace init --dry-run    # preview what would be done
  workspace init --force    # overwrite modified templates
  workspace init --install-hooks    # install agent session hooks without prompting
  workspace init --no-install-hooks    # skip the hooks step entirely
  workspace init --workflow-sources acme/workflows/presets    # list a workflow source in the global config
--- stderr
--- end
